KTR_white <- readRDS("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/EWAS_tk_ratio/ratio_kt_W.rds")

  "cg01409343", "cg18942579", "cg16936953", "cg12054453", "cg00490406",
  "cg01059398", "cg21979287", "cg08818207", "cg27537252", "cg03425812",
  "cg12828896", "cg03957124", "cg16306654", "cg03753191", "cg07878065", 
  "cg04176813", "cg07839457", "cg16411857", "cg23387863", "cg23904266", 
  "cg09249800", "cg11699125", "cg14496081", "cg07830828", "cg02068052", 
  "cg24741430","cg10636246",  "cg13575798", "cg26140475", "cg09801824"
)

ktr_filtered <- KTR_white[KTR_white$cpg %in% ordered_cpgs, ]

```{r}
# Manhattan-style plot
ggplot(ktr_filtered, aes(x = chr, y = logp, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = cpg), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cluster 1" = "blue", "Cluster 2" = "darkorange", "Cluster 3" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(
    title = "Manhattan Plot of Top 30 CpGs",
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

```

## Read in the files 

```{r cars}
# Set your directory path
folder_path <- "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS"  # change this to folder path

# List only files ending in _manhattan.txt
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path,
                        pattern = "_manhattan\\.txt$", 
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Read each file into a list of data frames
all_results <- lapply(file_list, read.table, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


names(all_results) <- gsub("_manhattan\\.txt$", "", basename(file_list))
list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "_manhattan\\.txt$") #confirm all files ending in manhattan has been picked up.

names(all_results)
```

# Map RsID with SNP ID 

```{r}

# Read in file safely using read.delim
snp_rs_map <- read.table("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS/allchr_rsids.txt",
                         header = TRUE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE)

View(snp_rs_map)


#Merge RsID in all CpG results using SNPID

all_results_mapped <- lapply(all_results, function(df) {
  df_merged <- merge(df, snp_rs_map, by = "SNPID", all.x = TRUE)
  return(df_merged)
})

# Keep the same names
names(all_results_mapped) <- names(all_results)
head(all_results_mapped[["cg00490406"]]) # all good 

```



#Create a loop

```{r}


# create a folder to save plots
output_dir <- "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS/plots"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir)
}

# Loop through each CpG result
for (trait_name in names(all_results)) {
  
  df <- all_results[[trait_name]]
  
  # Step 1: Filter out indels (non-single letter alleles)
  df_clean <- df %>%
    filter(str_length(non_coded_allele) == 1 & str_length(coded_allele) == 1)
  
  # Step 2: Handle case where no valid SNPs remain
  if (nrow(df_clean) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", trait_name, "- no valid SNPs after indel removal"))
    next
  }
  
  # Step 3: Plot and save
  output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(trait_name, "_manhattan_plot.png"))
  
  png(output_file, width = 1000, height = 600)
  manhattan(df_clean,
            chr = "Chr", 
            bp = "Position", 
            snp = "SNPID", 
            p = "P",
            main = paste("Manhattan Plot:", trait_name),
            genomewideline = -log10(5e-8),
            suggestiveline = -log10(1e-5),
            ylim = c(0, -log10(min(df_clean$P, na.rm = TRUE)) + 2))
  dev.off()
  
  cat(paste("Saved plot for", trait_name, "\n"))
}

```

#Create the Manhattan plot 

cg03425812
cg10636246

```{r}
hit_cpgs <- c("cg00490406", "cg01409343", "cg07878065", "cg12054453", 
              "cg13575798", "cg16936953", "cg18942579", "cg24741430",
              "cg03425812","cg10636246","cg01059398","cg03753191","cg07839457",
              "cg12828896")

# Combine cleaned data from only the 14 CpGs
combined_hits_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(hit_cpgs, function(cpg) {
    df <- all_results_mapped[[cpg]]
    df %>%
      filter(nchar(non_coded_allele) == 1 & nchar(coded_allele) == 1) %>%
      mutate(CpG = cpg)
  })
)

# Make sure chromosome and position are numeric
combined_hits_df <- combined_hits_df %>%
  mutate(Chr = as.numeric(as.character(Chr)),
         Position = as.numeric(as.character(Position))) %>%
  arrange(Chr, Position)

# Create cumulative base pair position for Manhattan layout
combined_hits_df <- combined_hits_df %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  mutate(BP_cum = Position + min(Position, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Axis labels for chromosomes
axis_df <- combined_hits_df %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  summarize(center = mean(BP_cum, na.rm = TRUE))

sig_hits <- combined_hits_df %>%
  filter(P < 5e-8 & !is.na(rsid))

combined_manhattan <- ggplot(combined_hits_df, aes(x = BP_cum, y = -log10(P), color = CpG)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
  geom_text_repel(data = sig_hits, aes(label = rsid), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 15) +
  scale_x_continuous(label = axis_df$Chr, breaks = axis_df$center) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(5e-8), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(1e-5), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Combined Manhattan Plot of Top 14 CpGs",
       x = "Chromosome",
       y = expression(-log[10](P))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS/Manhattan Plot of Top 14 CpGs.png", plot = combined_manhattan, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


```{r}
# Combine cleaned data from these CpGs
combined_hits_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(hit_cpgs, function(cpg) {
    df <- all_results_mapped[[cpg]]
    df %>%
      filter(nchar(non_coded_allele) == 1 & nchar(coded_allele) == 1) %>%
      mutate(CpG = cpg)
  })
)

# Convert to numeric and sort
combined_hits_df <- combined_hits_df %>%
  mutate(Chr = as.numeric(as.character(Chr)),
         Position = as.numeric(as.character(Position))) %>%
  arrange(Chr, Position)

# STEP 1: Calculate cumulative position using chromosome offsets
chromosome_offsets <- combined_hits_df %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  summarize(chr_len = max(Position, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(Chr) %>%
  mutate(offset = lag(cumsum(chr_len), default = 0)) %>%
  select(Chr, offset)

# Merge offset and compute cumulative position
combined_hits_df <- combined_hits_df %>%
  left_join(chromosome_offsets, by = "Chr") %>%
  mutate(BP_cum = Position + offset)

# STEP 2: Set axis labels per chromosome center
axis_df <- combined_hits_df %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  summarize(center = mean(BP_cum, na.rm = TRUE))

# STEP 3: Significant hits for labeling (with rsid)
sig_hits <- combined_hits_df %>%
  filter(P < 5e-8 & !is.na(rsid))

# STEP 4: Final plot
combined_manhattan <- ggplot(combined_hits_df, aes(x = BP_cum, y = -log10(P), color = CpG)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
 geom_text_repel(data = sig_hits, aes(label = CpG), size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = axis_df$center,
    labels = axis_df$Chr,
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(5e-8), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(1e-5), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Combined Manhattan Plot of Top 14 CpGs",
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = expression(-log[10](P))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 10, vjust = 0.5)
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS/Manhattan Plot of Top 14 CpGs.png",
  plot = combined_manhattan,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)



```


```{r}

# Filter for top SNP per CpG with genome-wide significance
sig_hits_top <- combined_hits_df %>%
  filter(P < 5e-8 & !is.na(CpG)) %>%
  group_by(CpG) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = P, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Manhattan plot with CpG labels (one per CpG)
combined_manhattan_2 <- ggplot(combined_hits_df, aes(x = BP_cum, y = -log10(P), color = CpG)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
  geom_text_repel(data = sig_hits_top, aes(label = CpG), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = axis_df$center,
    labels = axis_df$Chr,
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(5e-8), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(1e-5), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Combined Manhattan Plot of Top 14 CpGs",
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = expression(-log[10](P))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 10, vjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS/Manhattan Plot Top 14 CpGs - Single Label Each.png",
       plot = combined_manhattan_2, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
